reason: SHA-scoped non-cancelling source runs protected intermediate commits but retained redundant queued executions. Only the fully corrected final head has decision value.
change: Use one fixed concurrency group per RPC, Blockscout and Windows-dual workflow with cancel-in-progress enabled. The final workflow-specific commit cancels every older run in that transport and leaves one authoritative final-head run.
operational_freeze: No further commit may be added to the source branch until the final-head source result is consumed or a fatal code error is proven from its logs.
